items.title: Cyclone Arnab may bring severe weather to Andhra Pradesh and Odisha
items.text: The India Meteorological Department warned that a system over the Bay of Bengal could intensify into a very severe cyclonic storm before approaching the Andhra Pradesh coast near Bapatla and Visakhapatnam on 28 October. Forecasts warned of heavy rain, strong winds and possible landslides in parts of Odisha; the storm's track and intensity may still change.

items.title: Devdutt Padikkal falls one run short of a double century for India A
items.text: Playing New Zealand A in the first unofficial Test at Bert Sutcliffe Oval in Lincoln, Devdutt Padikkal was dismissed for 199 after facing 248 balls. He had resumed the day on 56 not out, reached his century in 128 balls and shared a 215-run third-wicket partnership with Sai Sudharsan, who scored 92.

items.title: India Women defeat Zimbabwe by 121 runs to clinch ODI series
items.text: India posted 328 for six in the second women's ODI at Vadodara, led by Harmanpreet Kaur's 126 and Deepti Sharma's unbeaten 106. Zimbabwe were dismissed for 207 in 48.5 overs, giving India a 121-run win and an unassailable 2–0 lead in the three-match series.

items.title: Indian painter Jogen Chowdhury dies in Kolkata at age 87
items.text: Modern Indian artist and former Rajya Sabha member Jogen Chowdhury died in Kolkata on 25 October at the age of 87, following a prolonged illness. He was known for distinctive line work and for blending traditional Indian imagery with contemporary styles. His career included art education, exhibitions and public service.

items.title: Operation Trident targets an international narcotics network across northeast India
items.text: The Narcotics Control Bureau and partner agencies carried out coordinated raids on 23 October across Assam, Mizoram and Manipur. The operation led to 18 arrests, the freezing of 1,424 bank accounts and the seizure of cash and other items while investigators traced alleged trafficking and hawala networks across borders.
